verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) is documented as a separate API/SMTP sending product (mailchimp-docs-2). It has its own rejection allowlist/denylist for suppression (mailchimp-docs-17) and dedicated IPs that can isolate sending reputation (mailchimp-docs-7). However, nothing in the pack shows transactional-specific templates or explicitly states that a receipt reaches a contact who unsubscribed from marketing. One hands-on report also says a single marketing complaint led Mailchimp/Mandrill to shut off the user's incoming support-ticket email (mailchimp-comm-8), which undercuts full account-level isolation. missing for 10: documented separate transactional templates, explicit marketing-unsubscribe bypass for transactional sends, evidence that marketing enforcement and reputation don't spill over to transactional, independent corroboration.
